d: Delightful countryside. On the left, in a short distance, glimpses Bassano. Knights, Dames, Vassalli, come to meet the Count of Salinguerra.
Magnificent hall in the palace of Ezzelino. Chorus.
Richard, Imelda, Knights, Dames, and sayings.
Princess's choir, Cuniza, sitting in Imelda.
Remote place in proximity to the gardens of the castle. Chorus of Knights.
Oberto in the choir of Knights.
Richard with his sword in his hand comes out as if pursued by anyone.
Cuniza and Imelda are drowned in the choir.
There comes a messenger of a letter to the Princess, and sayings.
